name: Sofa Stockade
description: The $sofa_stockade$ is in many aspects identical to a normal $stockade$. The usage of $a_sofa_infantry$ instead of levies or militia makes the $sofa_stockade$ a formidable hindrance to pass though.

name: Korean Barracks
description: Our armies need a steady supply of troops to keep them in prime condition. Having local centers of recruitment and training will allow us to have easily available reserves.

name: Provincial Garrison
description: The provinces are the pillars that sustain the [GetInternationalOrganizationType('middle_kingdom').GetName]. To defend them against any attacker, garrisons need to be established with a permanent station of soldiers.

name: Royal Court
description: The pinnacle of the state, the $royal_court$ is the center of the monarchs power and splendor.

name: House of Parliament
description: A building to house a permanent [parliament|e], to keep it central and under better control.

name: Order Headquarters
description: The residence of the Grand Master serves as the base of the Orders operations and is its political center.

name: Admiralty
description: The $admiralty$ is tasked with the protection of our maritime interests. With military and civil administration both represented in one, the balance of interest will be fairly represented.

name: War College
description: The $war_college$ serves as a place where veteran officers educate and train the coming generation of generals, ensuring the superiority of our army.

name: Tax Assessor
description: The $tax_assessor$ enforces the will of the ruler to collect the proper amount of taxation.

name: Supreme Court
description: Supervising the law of our country, the $supreme_court$ is the central institution to dictate and enforce our law.

name: Chancery
description: $chancery_advance_desc$

name: Republican Assembly
description: The heart of our republic and the cornerstone of our administration is none other than the $republican_assembly$, a place of deliberation where we elegantly exercise our power.

name: Royal Garden
description: The vast Royal Garden is a piece of paradise on Earth, a place where the nobles of the court can relax and engage in superfluous pastimes while enjoying the magnificent cultivated nature of the garden.

name: Pirate Stronghold
description: A wretched hive of scum and villainy, the most daring and illegal privateers, this building is the heart of a pirate republic.

name: Local Governor
description: A seat of regional authority that extends the reach of the state to its most distant lands, expanding its influence beyond its immediate surroundings. When connected to the capital by the road network, they act as hubs for governance and administration.

name: Italian Administration Center
description: A seat of Italian administrative tradition that extends the reach of governance over distant territories. Rooted in the civic institutions and legal culture of the Italian city-states, it imposes order and legitimacy on the lands it oversees.

name: Naval Governor
description: $local_governor_desc$

name: Central Bank
description: $central_bank_advance_desc$

name: Coastal Fort
description: As the threat of pirates and hostile fleets approaches, a set of rudimentary coastal fortifications are called for, to protect us from invasions.

name: Naval Battery
description: The natural evolution of defensive warfare has culminated in the development of intricate coastal defenses, ready to repel even the heaviest of hostile invasions.

name: Irrigation
description: The proper cultivation of our land is key to feeding our people and achieving prosperity. Extensive $irrigation_systems$ will secure much-needed food.

name: Bridge
description: Connecting various towns, cities, and settlements is vital to maintain the rule of law and central authority. By constructing a $bridge_infrastructure$ we will improve the movement of people and goods alike.

name: Pound Lock Canal
description: The manipulation of the tide and any rivers that run through our realm, are vital for our survival. A $pound_lock_canal_infrastructure$ would ensure our mastery over life-giving water.

name: Mason
description: Manned by skilled workers who cut and shape stone for construction, the $mason$ is essential for the construction of durable and lasting structures.

name: Mercury Patio
description: A $mercury_patio$ is a complex of buildings used to refine silver and gold extracted from lower quality ores, making them profitable.

name: Tar Kiln
description: Tar has been used since antiquity, as its sealing and waterproof properties are indispensable. Therefore, any forested area is fertile ground for kilns, used to extract tar from wood by the process of dry distilling it from it.

name: Stud Farm
description: Whether for war or for pulling the carts that carry our trade across the country, horses are needed everywhere. For this reason, families have begun breeding these magnificent steeds to meet these demands.

name: Stone Quarry
description: Stone is an excellent construction material used for houses, aqueducts, temples, bridges, and more. Unfortunately, it must be extracted, and high-quality building stone is not always abundant. To meet our needs, we can establish quarries in areas with good-quality material.

name: Lumbermill
description: Wood, by itself, has relatively low value unless it is cut into useful planks. To maximize its utility and ease of transportation, lumber mills are developed, allowing planks to be easily made from chopped trees.

name: Fiber Crops Farms
description: Various plant fibers are essential for producing ropes, shoes, clothes, and other goods needed by our population. By cultivating these crops, we can rely on our own production and reduce dependency on imports.

name: Sand Pit
description: Sand has many uses, including as a building material, but certain types of sand are also ideal for glassmaking when heated. We can create sandpits to extract this resource for our various needs.

name: Bog Iron Smelter
description: Iron is the basis of all metallurgy, and although proper and good sources of it are the best to have, some can also be extracted from places near water where it accumulates.

name: Clay Pit
description: Clay is crucial for our pottery industry and is also ideal for making tiles for our homes. We can establish clay pits in areas where this material is abundant, providing a reliable source for our potters.

name: Salt Collector
description: Salt has been a companion of human nutrition for millennia, and a highly appreciated good. Fortunately, the sea has it in abundance, so one must just capture its waters and let them dry to extract it. Alternatively, dried-up lakes or riverbeds are also good sources of easily obtainable salt.

name: Fruit Orchard
description: Fruits are a bountiful gift from nature, providing our population with a bountiful source of food. Orchards would serve as a steady production of fruit, fulfilling the needs of our people.

name: Local Council
description: A ruler cannot be in all places of the country at once. By delegating governance to local authorities, the authority of the court can be made manifest even in the most remote parts of our country.

name: Council Hall
description: Any form of local governance needs a proper place for its gatherings and adequate function. A building of sufficient size and equipment and with a big enough debating chamber are crucial.

name: Expanded Council Hall
description: The growth of towns and cities and the increased governmental needs consequently require an expansion of the building housing the local authorities, to be able to continue performing their function adequately. The increased size of archives and registers are all to serve as an expansion of the authority of the court itself.

name: University
description: A center of thought and innovation, the $university$ is home to bright minds of scientists and men of letters alike, all eager to promote growth and literacy.

name: Library
description: These secular institutions are studying and meeting places for scholars and the wealthy, where they can research many topics and learn about philosophy, mathematics, religion, and science. They can be independent but will often be linked to the patronage and influence of a University.

name: Confucian School
description: These learning institutions focus their efforts in the education and training of government officials in the Confucian ideals.

name: Confucian Academy
description: Private learning schools for elite-class students who are learning the Confucian teachings and ideals to pass the national service examinations.

name: Opera House
description: Magnificent and ornate buildings specialized in the display of opera performances and usually built thanks to the patronage of wealthy and influential individuals.

name: Theater
description: A building used by artists to perform plays, concerts and other theatrical works.

name: Jesuit College
description: Jesuits educate our population with a proper [ShowReligionAdjective('catholic')] education, reinforcing our conversion efforts with their presence.

name: Art School
description: $art_school_advance_desc$

name: Arts Academy
description: The $arts_academy$ is home to some of the most renowned artists and men of the pen within our realm. Cultivating our culture is a great way to leave a staple in the history books.

name: Toll Castle
description: A small fortification placed in or very close to a road, river crossing, or mountain pass, where a small contingent of guards can enforce the payment of a toll to be granted passage.

name: Nobility Fortifications
description: These medium-sized fortifications are used by the local nobility to exert their influence over their ancestral land and control the peasantry.

name: Rotten Borough
description: Represents a parliamentary borough with a very small electorate that can be corrupted, extorted or bribed to vote for a certain candidate.

name: Noble Villa
description: Nobility pride themselves with being separated from and above the normal rabble. As such, they enjoy having residences far away from major urban areas, but those residences will be magnificent and lavishly furbished nonetheless.

name: Local Noble Delegation
description: While they enjoy living apart from the urban centers to not have to share their space with commoners, nobility still wants to be actively involved in the events occurring inside main towns and cities, especially when it concerns to governance. As such, it is not uncommon for them to own residences everywhere they can gain from having influence in.

name: Nobles Recruitment Center
description: Nobility amass quite a bit of wealth, possessions that they want to protect. As a result, they tend to have their own personal guards and even army-ready troops, that they recruit from the local population into their direct service.

name: Local Estates
description: The power base of the Nobility lies in their extensive properties, generally agricultural lands that the peasants exploit, either through servitude or through rent.

name: Noble Courts
description: A key aspect of noble power is the ability to administer justice within their domains. This is carried out by a network of officials who enforce the laws of the nobility in their lands.

name: Noble's Mansion
description: Nobles typically use several residences, scattered throughout their domains, but also located in important centers of power. These mansions are the backbone of their estates and require constant maintenance of property and staff, ready to serve their lords.

name: Noble Sponsored Temple
description: One way nobles publicly demonstrate their devotion is by sponsoring temples in their territories. These are usually staffed by clergy who belong to their dynasty or are very close servants.

name: Cathedral
description: The $cathedral$ is a greater $temple$ building which offers religious services to a vastly greater number of the local population. As a religious center of the city, members of all classes make sure to visit this building for their worship.

name: Parish Church
description: The clergy wants to extend its influence as far as they can, to be sure that all the population has access to the true faith. Even the smallest settlement is apt to having a priest to attend the spiritual needs of the local population.

name: Local Shrine
description: Religion usually have places with significant spiritual relevance. In those places, the clergy will be quick to build local shrines to make sure that the population reveres these places properly.

name: Clerical Archives
description: The clergy tens to amass all kinds of knowledge, usually not only of theological nature. Their archives contain all kinds of writings and serve as a well of wisdom, albeit usually the access to them is quite restricted by the clergy themselves.

name: Spiritual Retreat
description: People dedicated to the faith strive to rise above earthly matters and get close to divinity. As a result, places emerge where they can go commune with their faith, apart from any worldly attachments.

name: Warrior Monks Training Grounds
description: Being dedicated to the faith does not necessarily mean that one must renounce violence. As such, there are many monks who dedicate themselves not only to the cultivation of their faith, but also to their military prowess.

name: Guild Hall
description: Local artisans will always have trouble making their products reach enough people if there is too much competition. As such, associations of them tend to establish guilds where they can decide on how a certain good has to be produced and distributed.

name: Merchants' Guild
description: Trade and commerce is what makes an economy flow. To make it flow naturally and more efficiently, traders organize themselves in guilds so that there is no obstruction among their different trade routes and instead all of them contribute to make the flow stronger.

name: Local Markets
description: No matter how isolated a settlement is, there are always people willing to travel to and from it to carry any goods and supplies the settlement may need, and profit from what it can produce. These merchants establish markets locally to allow the commerce flow.

name: Burgher Mansion
description: Even if they do not belong to the nobility, once someone has amassed enough wealth they will undoubtedly emulate the lives of those born with it. As such, rich burghers establish for themselves mansions as lavish as those of the higher nobility.

name: Artisan Guilds
description: Any product requires experience and skill to be produced. People able to do that thus establish workshops to be able to dedicate themselves to that production, and take in apprentices to pass on the skill.

name: Local Assembly
description: Commoners are at the mercy of the government, but they are not always completely separated from it. Assembling locally among themselves allows them to discuss the most important issues affecting them, and raise their concerns to the proper authorities.

name: Pirate Haven
description: Commoners depend on the strength of their arms to provide them sustenance. Some may even turn to robbery and piracy, especially in shores that not receive the proper attention from the government, where they can establish hidden coves from where to launch their raids on unsuspecting vessels.

name: Peasants Training Grounds
description: As long as common levies need to be call, it is beneficial for the population to have local training grounds where they can practice the basics of combat, so that at least they know which is the correct side of a sword.

name: Festival Grounds
description: As everyone, commoners are fond of merriment and celebrations every time they can have the opportunity. To that effect, specific grounds are designated to hold the festival and festivities in every settlement.

name: Peasants Hunting Grounds
description: If the commoners have legal permission to hunt, they will quickly establish specific grounds for that effect so that they can exploit the wildlife of any local forested area.

name: Local Schools
description: An educated populace is a productive one. As such, local schools will help educate the commoners and put them on par with the higher classes. It is thus of no one's surprise that they tend to favor such schools everywhere they can.

name: Local Newspaper
description: Information is knowledge, and knowledge is progress. Local newspaper agencies will thus help disseminate information about the current estate of events to the populace, to the benefit of all.

name: Free Village
description: A community of free peasants that was founded unencumbered by the obligations to the landlords typical of rural society.

name: Cantonments
description: A cantonment will serve our army as a permanent center of recruitment of military personnel and offer housing to our troops.

name: Grand Palace
description: The $grand_palace$ offers a grandiose display of the cultural achievements of our society, all prepared for our monarch and the people closest to them.

name: Great Madrasa
description: A place of higher learning, the $great_madrasa$ provides a place for our most esteemed scholars to spread their knowledge on medicine, architecture, and Islamic law.

name: Great Tibetan Monastery
description: A great center of [ShowReligionName('tibetan_buddhism')], it is the source of religious authority and [ShowReligionGroupAdjective('buddhist')] learning, as well as all monastic life.

name: Tower of Belém
description: Protecting the mouth of the Tagus River, the $tower_of_belem$ is both a military fortress capable of safeguarding our port and a symbol of our maritime dominance.

name: Fortezza di Sant'Andrea
description: This fort protected the city of Venice for over three hundred years.

name: Great Temple of Tenōchtitlan
description: Dedicated to the god of war, Huitzilopochtli, and the god of rain and agriculture, Tlaloc, the $great_temple_of_tenochtitlan$ with its stepped construction will allow us easy expansion in the future.

name: City Corporation
description: In the hand of merchants and traders, the $corporation_of_london$ controls much of the growth and development of $london$.

name: Grand Apartment
description: A symbol of the rulers control over $london$, the $grand_apartment$ imposes our control from the riverside.

name: Sanssouci
description: Situated outside the busy noise of our cities, $sanssouci$ is a modest palace of one story, surrounding by vast gardens and vineyards.

name: Berlin Palace
description: Built in the center of $berlin$ between the Spree and its channel the $berlin_palace$ will allow our rulers a greater control over $berlin$. Due to its troubled construction history, it also displays the power of our state to push their demands against all odds.

name: Versailles
description: The Palace of $versailles$ is a major complex of the royal residence with several salons, halls, chambers, a chapel and even an opera. Diplomats and members of the high circles come regularly to the palace to do their bidding with the $french_group$ royalty.

name: Enderûn Academy
description: The $enderun_academy$ is a palace and boarding school within the Topkapi Palace which educates students picked by the $devshirme_system_policy$ to become successful $janissaries_advance$ and $turkish_culture$ statesmen alike.

name: Imperial Arsenal
description: A massive complex of shipyards, dry docks, iron foundries, spinners, and even a hospital and a prison, this can truly be the fleet base of an empire.

name: Rock of Monaco
description: The $rock_of_monaco$ is a tall monolith of the city of Monaco. While the great rock of its own is of little importance, the city of Monaco around it serves as a local pirate haven in the Mediterranean Sea.

name: La Llotja de la Seda
description: La Llotja, a stunning architectural masterpiece, consists of three parts, including the #italic 'Sala de Contratació'#!, a lavishly decorated trading hall with twisted columns where merchants can negotiate contracts, and the Pavilion of the Consulate that serves as the seat for the #italic 'Tribunal del Mar'#!. The central tower of La Llotja is used as a prison for debtors.

name: Cámara de Comptos
description: The #italic $camara_comptos$#! is a sovereign court specializing in financial affairs. It takes inspiration in the institution of the same name in Paris.

name: Zwinger
description: This palatial complex serves as a festival and garden area, with space for a future castle.

name: Globe Theatre
description: This wooden open-air entertainment venue is likely to captivate audiences for many years ahead. Highly flammable.

name: Schwaz Silver Mine
description: The $schwaz_mine$ is a prosperous mine of plentiful silver and copper ores. The resources gathered by the mining operations shall finance the diplomatic and military campaigns of its owner for centuries to come.

name: Urban Parliament Seat
description: An $urban_parliament_seat$ is a seat of political power of the local $burghers$ inhabiting the city. The presence of such buildings increases the influence of the guilds and merchants significantly.

name: Ribeira das Naus
description: The Navy Arsenal site, formerly a medieval naval dockyard called #italic tercenas#!, witnessed a shift during King D. Manuel I's construction of the Paço da Ribeira. The establishment of new tercenas, known as #italic Ribeira das Naus#!, to the west of the royal palace, played a crucial role in building ships for the Portuguese Discoveries. These shipyards, the largest in the Portuguese Empire, served as a model for overseas establishments, notably in Goa and Cochin.

name: Papal Archives
description: The $papal_archives$ are a collection of Christian knowledge and history which are under the strict protection of the Papal States.

name: Vatican Library - Administrative Wing
description: The Vatican Apostolic Library is the vast library of the Holy See. It possesses collections of information and documentations from the classical period all the way to the current day.

name: Vatican Library - Diplomatic Wing
description: $adm_vatican_library_desc$

name: Vatican Library - Military Wing
description: $adm_vatican_library_desc$

name: Wisselbank of Amsterdam
description: The Bank of $amsterdam$, also known as the $wisselbank$ is an exchange bank which plays a significant role in the creation and defending of coinage standards. As the first of its kind, the $wisselbank$ influences new state banks all across $europe$.

name: Riksbank
description: The central national bank of $SWE$ it opperates under parliamentary oversight to ensure finantial stability and a strong currency for greater trading potential. Its presence will ensure the growth of $SWE_ADJ$ economy.

name: Bolshoi Theater
description: This Neoclassical cultural gem treats its audiences to world-class productions in ballet and opera. Deafening performances guaranteed.

name: Archive of the Indies
description: This archive is commissioned to host all the documentation regarding our overseas activities.

name: Petronium
description: The $bodrum_castle$ is the principal [GetCountry('KNI').GetAdjective] stronghold on the mainland of [ShowRegionName('anatolia_region')]. It features 4 towers built by four different participating nations, the English, French, Italian, and German, and it is a refuge for the Christians in the area.

name: Forbidden City
description: $forbidden_city$ is a structure so monumental, it is certainly the single palace that can stay true to how powerful the [GetInternationalOrganizationType('middle_kingdom').GetName] truly is.

name: Macau Treaty Port
description: $chi_macau_port$ represents territory leased to [GetCountry('POR').GetName]. Each year, the [GetCountry('POR').GetAdjectiveWithNoTooltip] people are forced to pay a hefty amount of gold as the land rent.

name: Franciscan Mission
description: $missionary_building_desc$

name: Collegium Poetarum et Mathematicorum
description: The College of Poets is a beacon of our investment into humanist studies and will provide the artists of our country with the best education possible.

name: Bibliotheca Corviniana
description: The $bibliotheca_corviniana$ is a renowned Renaissance library, containing a vast collection of manuscripts and books.

name: Hexamilion Wall
description: The $hexamilion_wall$, meaning #italic Six-Mile Wall#!, has existed since the ancient times in order to protect [ShowAreaName('morea_area')].

name: 'Ablaq Palace
description: An illustrious domicile that serves the Egyptian rulers, this building is adorned in the most beautiful 'Ablaq architecture. The holiness of its halls are used to produce a silk cover known as the Kiswa that covers the $kaaba$.

name: Falaj
description: The $oma_falaj$ is an underground aqueduct system that allows us to safely transport water to any location.

name: Nizwā Fort
description: The $oma_nizwa_fort$ is a vital spot for the [ShowGoodsName('incense')] trade in [ShowAreaName('oman_area')].

name: Dutch Trade Outpost
description: To strengthen their influence in [ShowRegionName('japan_region')], many #italic Dutch Traders#! maintain good relations with the rulers there whilst being free to trade.

name: Friesland Admiralty
description: $dutch_admiralty_desc_common$

name: West Friesland Admiralty
description: $dutch_admiralty_desc_common$

name: Rotterdam Admiralty
description: $dutch_admiralty_desc_common$

name: Zeeland Admiralty
description: $dutch_admiralty_desc_common$

name: Amsterdam Admiralty
description: $dutch_admiralty_desc_common$

name: Schönbrunn Palace
description: Constructed in the place of an old hunting lodge of our dynasty, this palace will serve as the summer residence for our ruler's family.

name: Teatro San Cassiano
description: $teatro_san_cassiano$ is the first public opera house in the world, marking a significant milestone in the history of performing arts and solidifying Venice's role as a leading cultural center.

name: Doge's Palace
description: The Doge's Palace in Venice serves as the residence of the Doge, the chief magistrate and leader of the Venetian Republic.

name: Library of $vijayanagar$
description: Sitting as one of the greatest educational centers in [ShowLocationName('vijayanagar')], this library will allow for our populace to be further educated.

name: City of Victory
description: The beacon of hope for Southern $india$, it sits as one of the greatest places in the world, where many scholars and ambassadors visit every year to see the civilization in [ShowLocationName('vijayanagar')].

name: $ranganathaswamy_temple$
description: After completely rebuilding the religious site in [ShowLocationName('srirangam')], it now stands as one of the greatest temples in all of Southern $india$.

name: Venkaṭeśvara Temple
description: Venkaṭeśvara and Tirupati have seen an increase in influence after recent donations, bringing it to new heights within [ShowAreaName('tamil_land_area')].

name: Piazza San Marco
description: Piazza San Marco, or St. Mark's Square, is the principal public square in Venice, Italy. It is renowned for its stunning architecture, including St. Mark's Basilica, the Campanile, or the Doge's Palace, and serves as the social, religious, and political heart of the city.

name: Walls of Ston
description: $walls_of_ston$ are a massive fortification chain protecting the trading city of Ragusa.

name: Collegium Helveticum
description: The $swi_collegium_helveticum$ educates the most talented clergymen of the Swiss people. Although not on Swiss ground directly, the Collegium is a prime destination for aspiring theologians.

name: Kastellet
description: $kastellet$ is a star-shaped fortress in Copenhagen, designed to protect the city from both land and sea attacks, featuring five bastions connected by thick walls, surrounded by a moat.

name: Kronborg
description: $kronborg$ Castle, located at the entrance of the Öresund Strait, has historically served as a key fortress for controlling and collecting sound dues from vessels navigating between the Baltic Sea and the North Sea.

name: Husuni Kubwa
description: An elaborate royal complex originally commissioned by [GetCharacter('zan_abu_al_mawahib_al_hasan_ibn_suleiman').GetName]. This residence featured beautiful [ShowCultureName('swahili_culture')] architecture, and is used for royal as much as mercantile duties, serving as the capital's de facto bargain and storage halls for the many merchants across our domain.

name: Magistrato alla Sanità
description: The Magistrato alla Sanità is a public health authority responsible for overseeing and managing measures to prevent and control the spread of diseases, particularly plague.

name: Imperial City of $hue_location$
description: The $imperial_city_of_hue$ is a walled enclosure within the citadel of the capital and serves as the seat of the imperial family of $DAI$.

name: Wat Chaiwatthanaram
description: A personal sponsor of our ruler, it serves as a place for the government's religious ceremonies, and for the funerary rites for our rulers and their families.

name: Observatory of Taqī ad-Dīn
description: This magnificent observatory stands on a hill with a great view of the night sky. If it lasts, it might greatly benefit the sciences in [ShowReligionGroupAdjective('muslim')] lands.

name: Castel Sant'Angelo
description: Originally built by Emperor Hadrian as a mausoleum for his family, $castel_sant_angelo$ has been rebuilt by the Popes to be one of the most formidable fortresses of [ShowLocationName('rome')].

name: Quirinal Palace
description: $quirinal_palace$ is the summer residence of the Popes, situated on the namesake hill overlooking the city of [ShowLocationName('rome')].

name: Debere Meshwa'e
description: Being a major [ShowBuildingTypeName('miaphysite_monastery')], [ShowBuildingTypeNameWithNoTooltip('debere_meshwae')] has given the [ShowEstateTypeName('clergy_estate')] of the lands more control, but also better living conditions.

name: Lighthouse of Alexandria
description: The $lighthouse_of_alexandria$ was a towering marvel and one of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World. Recently rebuilt, it now stands as a modern homage to its ancient legacy, guiding ships into Alexandria's harbor once again.

name: The Al-'Azhar Madrasa
description: The $al_azhar_madrasa$ is one of the world's oldest and most respected centers of Islamic learning, renowned for its scholarship in religion, law, and the Arabic language.

name: Indian Tomb
description: Hosting the body of a great man in $india$, this tomb serves as a great site for travelers as well as a sign of culture.

name: Rahdar
description: In order to protect the trade routes of [ShowRegionName('hindustan_region')], a highway patrol has to be established. It is known as the [ShowBuildingTypeName('rahdar')], where these men ensure the safety of trade within the area.

name: Red Fort
description: Ensuring that the location never falls into enemy hands, as well as a showcase of the prestige of its owner, the [ShowBuildingTypeName('red_fort')] has allowed us to project control over this location.

name: Portuguese Quarters
description: A resting place for wealthy merchants from overseas, these quarters serve as their permanent residence in $india$.

name: Mahmud Gawan Madrasa
description: Built with the intention of allowing many scholars from all over the globe to experience our culture, this Madrasa is seen as one of the greatest religious colleges in [ShowRegionName('deccan_region')].

name: Ambras Castle
description: The $ambras_castle$ is a medieval fortress reconstructed to serve as the seat of the dynasty as well as ceremonial and cultural place, housing an extensive collection of rare items gathered by our rulers.

name: Belvedere Palace
description: The $belvedere_palace$ is a large palace in Vienna renowned for its architectural grandeur and its role as a cultural hub, housing a vast collection of European art.

name: Palace of Holyroodhouse
description: The $sco_palace_of_holyroodhouse$ stands as a symbol of one of the many architectures from the [ShowCultureName('scottish')] Renaissance. A Grand Gothic palace, Holyroodhouse is one of the most treasured residences of the [GetCountry('SCO').GetGovernment.GetAdjective] family.

name: Louvre Museum
description: Once a symbol of $french_group$ royalty, the Louvre palace has been converted into a public museum, hosting the finest works of [GetCountry('FRA').GetNameWithNoTooltip].

name: Jayš Garrison
description: A garrison for the [ShowCultureGroupName('amazigh_group')] tribes to rest in, allowing for a better protection of the area.

name: Academy of Sciences
description: The $academy_of_sciences$ is the academic headquarters for prominent scientists, scholars, and intellectuals, both domestic and foreign, who contribute to a diverse and dynamic intellectual environment. It conducts extensive research in several fields, and publishes numerous scientific papers and journals.

name: Herrenchiemsee Abbey
description: A magnificent Baroque abbey located on the island of Chiemsee. It serves as a beacon of religious and cultural prominence, boosting literacy and promoting $BAV_ADJ$ traditions.

name: Medieval $munich$ Residenz
description: This marks the foundation of the [ShowLocationName('munich')] Residenz, the future seat of $BAV_ADJ$ rulers. Constructed as a stronghold to protect against rebellious subjects and rival factions, this building symbolizes the beginning of $BAV_ADJ$ power and authority centered in [ShowLocationNameWithNoTooltip('munich')].

name: $renaissance$ $munich$ Residenz
description: During the $renaissance$, the [ShowLocationName('munich')] Residenz underwent significant expansion, showcasing the grandeur and cultural achievements of $BAV$. This architectural masterpiece added halls of art and sophistication, elevating the prestige of [ShowLocationNameWithNoTooltip('munich')] as a cultural hub of the $hre$.

name: Baroque $munich$ Residenz
description: The Baroque expansion of the [ShowLocationName('munich')] Residenz reflects the splendor of the Enlightenment era. Lavish gardens, grand halls, and intricate designs emphasized the artistic and political dominance of the Wittelsbach dynasty in Bavaria and beyond.

name: General Archive of Simancas
description: The $general_archive_of_simancas$ is the first official state archive in Europe designed as a compact compound in a single building, created to centralize and preserve vital documents of the realm.

name: El Escorial
description: Built as the new residence of our monarchs in the same complex as a monastery of the Order of Saint Augustine, $el_escorial$ is a monument to the might and devoutness of our nation.

name: School of Salamanca
description: The $school_of_salamanca$ is an institution with the purpose of shaping modern thought in the disciplines of law, ethics, economy, and more.

name: Artillery Academy of Segovia
description: The $segovia_artillery_academy$ is the first academy of its kind that focuses on the study of the military utilization of artillery, playing a critical role in the innovations of modern cannonry.

name: American Academy of Arts and Sciences
description: The $usa_academy_of_arts_and_sciences$ will cultivate every art and science which may tend to advance the interest, honor, dignity, and happiness of a free, independent, and virtuous people.

name: American Philosophical Society
description: The $usa_philosophical_society$ will promote useful knowledge and maintain our country at the forefront of scientific progress.

name: First Bank of America
description: The $usa_national_bank$ will back our government and stabilize our currency.

name: Mint of America
description: The $usa_national_mint$ will regulate and improve the process of minting our currency.

name: The Cipher Secretary
description: The Cipher Secretary is a state-run office that encrypts messages of merchants and diplomats to protect the interests of the Republic.

name: Phanariot District
description: The district where the Phanariots, wealthy [ShowCultureName('greek_culture')] merchants, reside in [ShowLocationName('constantinople')].

name: Maniot Toll Guards
description: By having the right over the roads in this location, the Maniots, who are a group of bandits within [ShowAreaName('morea_area')], control much of the administration and trade there.

name: Administration Center of $bulgaria_area$
description: This location serves as the center of all of the administration within [ShowAreaName('bulgaria_area')].

name: [ShowReligionAdjectiveWithNoTooltip('judaism')] District
description: A district for the [ShowReligionAdjective('judaism')] people to reside in.

name: Darüşşifa
description: A hospital built during the $ilkhanate$. It is seen as one of the most advanced hospitals in the entire world, and is treated as a center of applied medical sciences.

name: Woodhenge of Cahokia
description: Aligned with the movement of the sun, the $woodhenge_of_cahokia$ serves as a method of tracking solar events.

name: Sevilla Bullfighting School
description: The $sevilla_bullfighting_school$ is the first official institution dedicated to the training of matadors for this iconic cultural tradition.

name: Royal Audience and Chancery
description: The $royal_audience_and_chancery$ is a judiciary institution and our highest court with the authority over the entire nation, symbolizing our royal legal authority.

name: Charité
description: The $charite_of_berlin$ is quarantine site outside of Berlin's walls that helps in containing recurring plagues.

name: Walls of $lucca$
description: The defense of the people is what matters the most for the watch. It is why these walls exist: to ensure no civilian dies.

name: Luccan Silk Production Guild
description: Being able to feed fiber crops to the worms in order to create silk, this location has managed to achieve an autonomous production method, one that does not depend on the Silk road.

name: Sienese Port
description: As the maritime influence of [ShowLocationName('siena')] expanded, this port was constructed to allow merchants to conduct their trade.

name: Trade Office
description: Trading and commerce are the lifeblood of any prosperous city. The $trade_office$ ensures that our merchants gain more opportunities to establish profitable relations with foreign traders.

name: Embassy
description: The forefront of diplomacy and the meeting place where representatives of foreign nations conduct negotiations and forest potential alliances.

name: Mission
description: The $missionary_building$ is the local center for religious ambassadors and missionaries who aim to convert the local natives to the one true faith.

name: Slave Center
description: The business with slaves is handled in the $slave_center$. Wealthy entrepreneurs come here to acquire slave labor while raiders and pirates sell their captives.

name: Overseas Trading Post
description: The $overseas_trading_post$ is an outpost of ambitious merchants who seek their luck and fortune in the business in lands far removed from their home country.

name: Colonial Administration
description: Overseas colonies are often hubs for the exchange of a wide variety of goods and products. As a result, the administrative dependencies also flourish, supporting and regulating the activities of colonial traders.

name: Merchant Guild Chapel
description: A chapel attached to an urbanized community, sponsored by the wealthy merchants who profit from ongoing mercantile traffic. It is a place of worship dedicated to a patron saint and operates as a vault of knowledge for manuscripts and scripture alike.

name: Viceroyalty
description: The Viceroyalty is the crown's administrative and commercial seat in a colonial nation subject, built by the overlord in the subject's capital. It serves as the viceroy's residence and organizes imperial trade, channeling colonial revenue back to the overlord while supporting the colonial capital as a trade hub.

name: Stockade
description: A $stockade$ is an enclosure of usually wooden palisades or other forms defensive walls. Although not as impressive as a $castle$, the $stockade$ can slow down enemy efforts to occupy the location.

name: Castle
description: A $castle$ is usually a fortified residence of the nobility or the headquarters of a military order. However, the $castle$ here serves first and foremost as a defensive structure protecting the location from invading forces.

name: Bastion
description: Due to the advances of $army_artillery$, the $castle$ is no longer sufficient to withstand the power of gunpowder. The $bastion$ negates the advantage of the cannon thanks to its superior design, offering them a greater passive resistance and more space for ranged defenses.

name: Star Fort
description: Unlike its predecessor, the medieval $castle$, the $star_fort$ is a very flat fortification composed of many triangular bastions at its corners and an additional ditch. This allows the defenders to counter enemy $army_artillery$ while still being able to keep climbing infantry at bay.

name: Fortress
description: The $fortress$ is the most advanced defensive structure, created by military engineers to withhold the power of the most advanced artillery. They are complex compounds, made of interconnected bastions and casemates, which are designed to maximize the defensive firepower.

name: City Walls
description: Great fortifications that encircle an entire city, $city_walls$ provide protection against invaders and a sense of security for its inhabitants.

name: $hre_imperial_armory$ (Abroad)
description:
An $hre_imperial_armory$ provides the Emperor with manpower for their armies.

#Y Turns into [ShowBuildingTypeName('hre_imperial_armory_own')] when the [location|e] gets owned by the [ShowSpecialStatusName('emperor')].#!

name: $hre_imperial_armory$ (Domestic)
description:
An $hre_imperial_armory$ provides the Emperor with manpower for their armies.

#Y Turns into [ShowBuildingTypeName('hre_imperial_armory_foreign')] when the [location|e] is no longer owned by the [ShowSpecialStatusName('emperor')].#!

name: Sergeantry
description: A $sergeantry$ is the building where sergeants live and train. Sergeants, derived from the Latin #italic serviens#!, 'servants', are the armed retinue that monarchs use in feudal systems, making them the core professional soldiers in their armies.

name: Warrior Temple
description: A $warrior_temple$ is the building from where [ShowUnitDefinitionName('a_jaguar_warrior')] and [ShowUnitDefinitionName('a_eagle_warrior')], the elite warriors of [ShowReligionAdjective('nahuatl')] countries, can be recruited.

name: Armory
description: The development of [ShowInstitutionName('professional_armies')] has created the need of getting new sources of [manpower|e] for our [armies|e]. The $armory$ can be built in [towns_and_cities|e] to increase it.

name: Training Fields
description: The $training_fields$ can be built in [rural_location|e] as another source of [manpower|e] for our [armies|e].

name: Barracks
description: The $barracks$ are a more efficient way of increasing the [manpower|e] we need for our [armies|e] by replacing the $armory$ in [towns_and_cities|e].

name: Regimental Camp
description: The $regimental_camp$ is a more efficient way of increasing the [manpower|e] we need for our [armies|e] by replacing the $training_fields$ in any [rural_location|e].

name: Conscription Center
description: The $conscription_center$ is the most efficient building increasing the [manpower|e] needed for our [armies|e]. It replaces the $barracks$ in [towns_and_cities|e] and the $regimental_camp$ in any [rural_location|e].

name: Jurchen Barracks
description: These barracks serve as a meeting point for our soldiers, to prepare for battle, train our skills and maintain our proud traditions.

name: Théma Headquarters
description: The administrative and military centers that make up the [ShowGovernmentReformName('theme_system')], these headquarters serve both as the rallying points for our imperial army and local governorship positions for our generals.

name: City Guard
description: Even without a hierarchic organization, there needs to be someone in charge of enforcing law and order. Citizens recruited into the $city_guard$ will serve as the backbone of or military arm.

name: Entrepôt
description: Located at the heart of a bustling and vibrant market, the $entrepot$ is the best place for our mercantile efforts to flourish.

name: Trading Hub
description: A vital point across our trade network, the $trading_hub$ constitutes a great place to sell and purchase many exotic and local goods.

name: Customs House
description: Our realm is home to a lively market, with many merchants importing fascinating goods from far-away lands. The regulation of such goods and the control of this flow, falls under the jurisdiction of the $customs_house$.

name: Stock Exchange
description: An important meeting place of brokers, merchants and investors, the $stock_exchange$ greatly facilitates business and the flow of shares in joint-stock companies.

name: Clearing House
description: The exchange of payments and advanced transactions are some of the principal conducts of business within our realm. The $clearing_house$ offers the environment to further increase our grip across the trade that flows through our realm.

name: Market Warehouse
description: The increased volume of goods that flow to and from our markets, demand an increase in our capacity to store them, through the construction of a $market_warehouse$.

name: Funduq
description: A public building found in important trade cities where merchants can rest, meet, and store their wares.

name: Black Market
description: An illicit market where goods are traded away from the watchful eye of any authority, free from taxation and the grabby hands of bailiffs.

name: Smugglers' Cove
description: The transportation of illegal goods as well as the commercial development of black markets hinge on the development of hidden coastal inlets or secluded harbors such as the $smuggler_cove$.

name: Brothel
description: The source of vice and debauchery, brothels are places for entertainment for pirates, privateers, and other ruffians.

name: Harbor Tavern
description: Lively and notorious hubs where men of action, sailors, and merchants gathered. Located in key pirate ports and various coastal towns, these taverns play an essential role in pirate life. Here, crews relax, spend their plunder on alcohol, food, entertainment, and recruited new crew members.

name: Sugar Plantation
description: The cultivation of land and sugarcane is a wealthy endeavor. By erecting a $sugar_plantation$ we may succeed in getting a foothold in the lucrative $sugar$ trade.

name: Cotton Plantation
description: The fields across our realm can be utilized to produce massive amounts of $cotton$, a sought-after commodity, through organized plantations.

name: Tobacco Plantation
description: The cultivation of $tobacco$ through the construction of a $tobacco_plantation$ will not only contribute to our prosperity, but also provide a share of the earnings of a wealthy trade.

name: Dock
description: A dock is the most basic shore infrastructure that allows for the building and repairing of boats.

name: Dry Dock
description: It is a port building that provides the necessary infrastructure to construct and repair boats in isolated dry basins that can be flooded at will. This ease of access to the hull of the ship improves in great measure the efficiency and capacity of the building process.

name: Shipyard
description: The Shipyard expands the capabilities of our port to new heights, increasing the number of vessels that can be serviced and built while also augmenting the amenities for the crew of those ships.

name: Grand Shipyard
description: This massive port infrastructure is a sight to behold, with innumerable vessels and sailors coming and going at any given time. Its ability to build and repair whole fleets make it a pinpoint for our expanding maritime power.

name: Naval Base
description: A whole section of the coast has been enclosed and specialized for the construction and maintenance of our grand fleet. This small city of sailors, craftsmen, and engineers is capable of building entire navies by itself, making it one of the most important strategic centers of our country.

name: Protected Harbor
description: Some places are more naturally suited to serve as a harbor than others, but with the proper infrastructure those conditions can be improved anywhere.

name: Brewery
description: A guild where grains or fruits can be transformed into delicious and intoxicating drinks enjoyed by all classes.

name: Beer Workshop
description: Brewed in larger workshops with ample storage for the process of fermentation, we will be able to produce larger quantities of alcoholic drinks than before.

name: Large-scale Brewery
description: The necessity for huge amounts of brewed drinks is resulting in more centralized centers of production where the old artisanal process has been systematic and mechanized.

name: Brewery Mill
description: Large Breweries will be able to utilize steam powered engines and automatized mechanism to increase the output of their facilities.

name: Scriptorium
description: A specialized center where scribes meticulously copy manuscripts, the $scriptorium$ produces a variety of texts of religious, legal or even literary nature, in an effort to preserve and disseminate knowledge.

name: Printers Shop
description: Utilizing easily produced and replaceable parts the $printing_press_shop$ will reduce both our cost in labor and materials to produce and spread written documents among our population.

name: Printing Manufactory
description: The introduction of new printing techniques allows printers to produce more $books$ than before.

name: Printing Mill
description: New techniques involving the usage of chemicals and more durable print plates allows the mass production of $books$.

name: Cannon Maker
description: A guild specialized in crafting and assembling cannons. These powerful weapons are essential for sieges and defense.

name: Cannon Workshop
description: The ever-increasing demand of artillery for our armies requires us to increase the capabilities of the $cannons$ production.

name: Cannon Foundry
description: In a $cannon_foundry$ cannons are cast and assembled from molten metal. Key for equipping armies with artillery, enhancing a state's military capabilities.

name: Cannons Factory
description: A large-scale factory where cannons were manufactured in bulk. Its expanded production capacity is a great way to facilitate the growing needs of our military forces.

name: Spinners' Guild
description: The production of various textiles is often a cornerstone of a realm's economy. The $cloth_guild$, which includes dyers, weavers, and fullers, maintains a steady production as well as a set of standards to ensure the quality and volume needed.

name: Cloth Workshop
description: Easier methods of cleaning fibers and dedicated workshops for the production of $cloth$ will increase the output of our textile industries.

name: Textile Manufactory
description: $cloth$ represents the various fabrics and clothing made from wool and linen. The $cloth_manufactory$ specializes in the production of $cloth$ from various materials such as $wool$, $cotton$ and $fiber_crops$.

name: Textile Mill
description: Powered by Waterwheels, a $textile_mill$ can mass-produce $cloth$ at rapid speed.

name: Dye Maker
description: For as long as textiles have been woven there has been a market for fine $dyes$. The $dyes_guild$ creates $dyes$ from available plants.

name: Dyes Workshop
description: Dyes and pigments can be created from a variety of sources, but they need to be processed in a certain manner, usually only known to a selected people.

name: Dyesworks
description: A dedicated and expanded dyes production will ensure that our population gets access to as much variety of pigments and colors as they desire.

name: Dyes Mill
description: Only by extensive manufactories dedicated to the production of various dyes, will we be able to satisfy the increasing need for pigments and fancy colors.

name: Tailors' Guild
description: The need for luxury textiles such as finely-woven $wool$, silk, and velvet, is a lucrative business that often involves the aristocracy. Developing advanced techniques for weaving and finishing fabrics, these centers of innovation often contribute greatly to local and state economies.

name: Fine Cloth Workshop
description: Easier methods of cleaning fibers and dedicated workshops for the production of $fine_cloth$ will increase the output of our textile industries.

name: Fine Cloth Manufactory
description: $fine_cloth$ is traditionally a marker of status for the elites and wealthy classes. The $fine_cloth_manufactory$ focuses on the crafting of these valuable textiles using $cloth$ or $silk$.

name: Fine Cloth Mill
description: Powered by Waterwheels, a $fine_cloth_mill$ can mass-produce $fine_cloth$ at rapid speed.

name: Hand Cannon Guild
description: $hand_cannon_guild_advance_desc$

name: Gunsmith
description: Dedicated to the production and maintenance of firearms, the $gun_smith$ produces various quality firearms as well as related components such as barrels, locks, and triggers.

name: Guns Workshop
description: The ever-increasing demand of guns for our armies requires us to increase the capabilities of the $firearms$ production.

name: Firearms Manufactory
description: Often described as the lifeblood of our military production complex, the $firearms_manufactory$ produces firearms of many shapes and sizes such as pistols, rifles, and more.

name: Firearms Factory
description: The rising demands of protecting our borders come with an increase in the production and demand quotas from our military production complex. This need is met by the $firearms_factory$ where large quantities of guns are made.

name: Carpenters' Guild
description: Carpentry is one of the most basic activities for supporting a household. Organizing into guilds allows carpenters to establish standards and share techniques that facilitate the sustainability of their work.

name: Furniture Workshop
description: With the rising wealth of our burghers so rises their demand for goods like $furniture$. Shifting the production into larger workshops will ensure more $furniture$ can be produced.

name: Furniture Manufactory
description: Artisanal carpentry might not be enough to meet the demand for furniture, especially in urban environments filled with bourgeoisie eager for more specific products. Organizing furniture manufacturing in larger workshops might be necessary to meet this growing demand.

name: Furniture Mill
description: Rising social wealth generates a growing demand for manufactured goods such as furniture. The only way to continue increasing supply may be to produce them in factories using industrial methods.

name: Glass Guild
description: The art of shaping $glass$ and producing items from it, is a delicate one. Specialized centers produce a range of goods from practical containers to decorative stained windows.

name: Glass Workshop
description: $glass$ is a vital part of the every-day needs of our entire population. The increased capabilities of the $glass_workshop$ will ensure that our efforts will not grind to halt.

name: Glassworks
description: Refinement of traditional Glassblowing techniques and the addition of new materials make it easier to mass-produce $glass$.

name: Glass Mill
description: Dedicated $glass_mill$ industries will be able to increase our production of $glass$ further than ever before. By rolling molten glass on iron tables, we will not only be able to increase the size of our produced $glass$ but also significantly speed up the manufacturing process.

name: Lacquerware Artisans' Guild
description: Combining sap from lacquer trees in multiple layers, gives the produced items their signature glossy finish, in a $lacquerware_guild$. Such sought-after high quality items include furniture, ceremonial boxes, and more. Lacquerware is highly valued for its beauty and resilience.

name: Lacquerware Manufactory
description: Refinements of the process of painting and applying the lacquer make $lacquerware$ cheaper and quicker to produce.

name: Tannery
description: Responsible for the production of leather, the $tannery$ produces important items such as shoes, saddles, and book bindings. Utilizing advanced techniques to manipulate animal hides, the tanner ensures the durability as well as aestheticism of $leather$.

name: Tanning Workshop
description: The production of $leather$ has refined and allows for a wider scope of produced hide materials and increased output.

name: Tanning Manufactory
description: Advancements in chemistry make the process of tanning animal hides significantly shorter and produce higher quality $leather$

name: Tannery Mill
description: With the use of new chemicals and more efficient production methods, our $leather$ production will be unrivaled.

name: Distillers' Guild
description: This brotherhood of Distillers controls the secrets and manufactory of any distilled goods in the town. All that want to learn that trade are forced to join them and expand their monopoly.

name: Distillers Workshop
description: By distilling in larger workshops with ample storage for aging, we will be able to produce larger quantities of alcoholic drinks.

name: Liquor Manufactory
description: A center of production where the secrecy of an old time guild is drowned by the great demand for increased amounts of distilled goods. This need has shaped a new and modern system of production that prioritizes quantity and profit.

name: Distiller Mill
description: Large Distilleries will be able to utilize steam powered engines and automatized mechanism to increase the output of their facilities.

name: Naval Supplies Guild
description: $naval_supplies$ represent everything needed in ship construction, from basic wood to tar, ropes, linen, sails, and various other materials. While a vast and diverse trade good, the $naval_supplies_guild$ covers all the materials needed for ship building.

name: Naval Supplies Workshop
description: $naval_supplies$ play a vital role in the supply and upkeep of our maritime ambitions. With bigger production spaces we will be able to maintain our position and increase our output.

name: Naval Supplies Manufactory
description: Similar to the $naval_supplies_guild$, so does the $naval_supplies_manufactory$ focus on the production of $naval_supplies$. Thanks to its increased dimensions, the output of available supplies for the ship construction is significantly higher.

name: Naval Supplies Mill
description: The steady increase in trading across the globe requires more $naval_supplies$ than ever before and dedicated mills are required to supply it.

name: Papermakers' Guild
description: $paper$ is the cornerstone of every realm, as it is used in every aspect of it, from administration to education and even trade. Thus, the $paper_guild$ ensures the proper standard of production and volume, as well as a unique technique that involves the soaking, pulping or pressing of basic supplies such as linen, cotton or other plant fibers.

name: Paper Workshop
description: $paper$ is a necessity for all types of advanced accounting, administration, and diffusion of knowledge. The $paper_workshop$ specializes in the creation of new $paper$ with lump, $fiber_crops$ and $lumber$.

name: Paper Manufactory
description: The increasing demand for $paper$ due to the printing industry forces innovative methods to up the production of $paper$ as well.

name: Paper Mill
description: Utilizing $cloth$ made from $cotton$, a $paper_mill$ will be able to produce higher quantities of paper.

name: Porcelain Kiln
description: $porcelain$ is a type of ceramics characterized by its strength and translucence due to the vitrification of the materials caused by high temperatures. The $porcelain_guild$ specializes in the creation and decoration of such wares.

name: Porcelain Manufactory
description: The production of $porcelain$ is the result of long alchemical experiments, allowing an alternative to the expensive import from overseas.

name: Potters' Guild
description: Pottery making is one of humanity's oldest economic activities. The association of potters in guilds fosters the exchange of knowledge and the specialization of work, allowing for greater ceramic production.

name: Pottery Workshop
description: Pottery is a staple in all population, from simple storage vessels to ornamentation objects. Streamlining its production in specialized workshops will serve to satisfy the people's need for pottery.

name: Pottery Manufactory
description: The growing demand for commercialized ceramics has led to the creation of economies of scale. The production of manufactured goods using a common, organized workflow, renders pottery-making no longer a craft profession.

name: Pottery Mill
description: The growth in the supply generated by manufactured ceramics has led to its ultimate logical consequence: the development of mass production, in which industrial workers are now responsible for producing the ceramics.

name: Saltpeter Guild
description: Produced through a labor-intensive process, $saltpeter$ is vital for the production of gunpowder, and thus state defense. It is extracted from nitrate-rich soils as well as manure or decaying organic matter.

name: Saltpeter Workshop
description: With the increasing demand for gunpowder by our forces, a reliable production of artificial $saltpeter$ is a necessity.

name: Putrefaction Works
description: $saltpeter$ is a valuable chemical compound which finds its uses as a fertilizer, salt for meat processing and as key ingredient for gunpowder. The $putrefaction_works$ serves as an alternative way to gain $saltpeter$ for cases where mining operations are not available.

name: Putrefaction Mill
description: By increasing the quantity of our boilers for the process of concentrating the $saltpeter$ and improving their reliability, we will be able to increase the production of gunpowder for our troops without the reliance on costly imports.

name: Tools Guild
description: Be it from the simple hammer to the first machine tools; $tools$ have been always a major part of our society. The $tools_guild$ specializes in producing these handy devices.

name: Tools Workshop
description: With the expanding of our economy, no longer can our people rely on artisan-made tools. The establishment of proper workshops for the production of tools for our population and business has become a necessity.

name: Iron Foundry
description: $tools$ made from $iron$ will be sturdier than any other known production while not requiring the same time-consuming crafting process.

name: Iron Mill
description: Utilizing blast furnaces, the $iron_mill$ will produce $tools$ at much higher quantity than any other method available.

name: Weaponsmith
description: An association of craftsmen responsible for the production of various weapons, guilds such as this are a pillar for state defense, supplying the common soldier with arms tailored to specific martial needs and volume.

name: Weapon Workshop
description: The ever-increasing demand of weapons both for our armies and our hunting operations requires us to increase the capabilities of the $weaponry$ production.

name: Weaponry Manufactory
description: Various weapons such as swords, pikes, and bows make up the core $weaponry$ of every army. Using various materials, the $weapon_manufactory$ creates melee and simple ranged weapons of all types.

name: Weapon Mill
description: Military importance has increased much more in recent years. As such, better and new methods of producing armament for our soldiers are needed, and entire factories dedicated for such purpose are being established.

name: Winery
description: A humble guild where various raw sugars are fermented into rich and intoxicating beverages. Though simpler than traditional grape wine, these drinks are enjoyed by commoners and nobles alike, each region perfecting its own distinct flavors and techniques.

name: Winery Manufactory
description: The ever-growing demand for refined fermented drinks has led to the creation of vast production centers where tradition meets industry. Ancient methods of wines are scaled up to serve bustling cities and far-reaching trade networks, ensuring no cup is left empty.

name: Apothecary
description: An apothecary is a place where medicines can be found and dispensed. These come from a variety of sources, including herbs and other natural remedies, but also from more exotic materials, such as animal horns or mercury.

name: Jewelers' Guild
description: The manipulation of gems, and valuable stones into jewels of the highest quality, makes the $jewelry_guild$ a sought-after occupation due to its perceived profit.

name: Steel Mill
description: An increase in the reliability of our furnaces and production process made it possible to produce $steel$ on an economically beneficial scale.

name: Perfumery
description: Cultivating flowers and extracting their essence, the $perfumery$ produces a luxury good for the wealthy.

name: Monastery
description: A place for seclusion and contemplation, monasteries are a refuge for those that want to dedicate their lives to communion with the heavens. Their grounds are thus for study and reflection, and great knowledge is usually guarded behind their walls.

name: Fortress Church
description: The $fortress_church$ is a building with a dual purpose. It serves its community as a normal church with all its religious functions, but is also used in case of sieges as a defensive building.

name: Madrasa
description: A center of knowledge dedicated to the promotion of studies, madrasas gather within their walls many students, many of them having often come from afar. Both earthly and religious matters are discussed inside, and their wisdom is for all to hear.

name: Sufi Lodge
description: A place for spiritual Sufi practice and education in religious mysticism, a $sufi_lodge$ is a center of Sufi devotion. Referred to by different names such as khānaqāh, zāwiya, ribāṭ, dargāh, and takya, its construction and funding represents an act of piety and serves as proof of the support of Sufi practices and the spread of [ShowReligionGroupName('muslim')].

name: Orthodox Monastery
description: $orthodox$ clergy tend to have a strong grip on power and authority, and their monasteries serve as the seat of such power. Being under the protection of the icons they hold, they are the custodians of the country's traditional values.

name: Miaphysite Monastery
description: $miaphysite$ is full of rites and ceremonies that have been performed since the beginning of $christian$. Monasteries are the keepers of those rites, as only within their walls is the word of God diligently and meticulously studied.

name: Bailiff
description: The population left to their own devices is just a nest of wickedness and laziness. As such, the rule of the country needs to be imposed via local representatives, tasked with keeping law and order in every settlement.

name: Fishing Village
description: Water is the source of life, and thus it is full of life. It is not uncommon for whole villages to be able to develop on any shore by taking advantage of such plentiful environment, and for people there to make their living out of any water creature they can capture.

name: Farming Village
description: Food is what makes a civilization run. Fields and farm plots can not only feed the populace, but also allow them to keep many other animals fed too and obtain other products from them. This combination is key to make any settlement thrive.

name: Forest Village
description: Forests and the wild lands are not as inhospitable as one might think, for their lands are plentiful in animals that can be hunted, both for their meat and their hides. As such, people are usually eager to settle near any forest with abundant animal life they can exploit.

name: Market Village
description: As trade hubs are needed to gather all the trade in specific areas, they emerge to fulfill that role and give rise to small burgher communities.

name: Rural Glassmaker
description: A small rural workshop where skilled craftsmen transform locally sourced sand into glass through the art of glassblowing. The $rural_glassmaker$ supplies glass goods to local markets and provides a modest source of income for the surrounding community.

name: Rural Clothmaker
description: A small guild where textiles were handcrafted using local materials. It plays a vital role in local economies, providing clothing and trade goods.

name: Charcoal Kiln
description: Charcoal is burned to heat our homes and fuel our forges. By burning the plentiful wood available to us, we can produce charcoal, which generates more heat than the wood does in its raw form.

name: Charcoal Burner
description: Improvements to the Charcoal Burning process allow us to output greater quantities and have a more efficient conversion rate.

name: Elephant Hunting Grounds
description: Due to their size, elephants cannot simply be bred on regular farms like horses or cows. Instead, we will establish elephant hunting grounds, which will function as semi-wild farms, allowing us to select those elephants that best meet our needs.

name: Windmill
description: Windmills come in various shape and sizes, as well as diverse sails structure and mechanisms, but they all serve to harness the power of wind to crush grain. As a result, the nutritious value of crops can be greatly improved, and transformed into a wider range of prepared foods.

name: Rural Smelter
description: Mother Earth is abundant in metal resources, but little can be done with them unless they are smelted first. As such, smelters tend to be established near where the metals are extracted, to prepare them for easier transportation and further processing elsewhere.

name: Sawmill
description: Forested areas provide ample material, but one cannot just simply make a house out of a tree. After a tree is felled, it needs to be processed in a sawmill before it can be put to good use. Through sawmills, raw timber is transformed intro proper wood.

name: Sheep Farms
description: While our shepherds already breed sheep in our meadows and hills, we need a more farm-like approach to increase productivity. Sheep farms will breed larger numbers of sheep for greater output.

name: Settlement
description: This represents creating a new settlement with basics such as stores, basic construction support, and trade posts, to encourage migrants to the location.

name: $ZAN_ADJ$ Shipwrights
description: Skillful masters of shaping palm wood and cotton into sea-faring vessels, this building facilitates the expansive navy under our command, supporting our maritime endeavors.

name: Lutheran Preachers
description: As members of the $reformation$, the $lutheran_preachers$ represents the local missionaries of the $lutheran_ADJ$ faith who spread their teachings to all nearby $catholic_ADJ$ people.

name: Calvinist Preachers
description: As members of the $reformation$, the $calvinist_preachers$ represents the local missionaries of the $calvinist_ADJ$ faith who spread their teachings to all nearby $catholic_ADJ$ people.

name: Temple
description: A $temple$ is a place of worship dedicated for the religious duties of the $clergy_estate$. Although temples can come in different shapes and forms depending on the local religion, its purpose remains all the same.

name: Construction Center
description: This allows more constructions to be done at the same time in an [town_or_city|e].

name: Counting House
description: The $counting_house$ is an office which keeps track of the financial books of the businesses of the town. Appointments and correspondences related to businesses related to payments are handled as well.

name: Minting Office
description: The $minting_office$ is the main manufacturing building which creates the currency of the state. Different metals enter the office to be forged into coinage for the public.

name: Granary
description: The $granary$ is a storage facility which prevents stored food from being contaminated by mice and other animals. It also increases the capacity of food available to the population in times of need.

name: Agadir
description: A fortified communal granary traditionally built by the people of North Africa. Built over hills, they provide protection and defensive points for the surrounding farmlands and prairies.

name: Grain House
description: A separated grain storage from the normal granary, the $grain_house$ will be able to support our troops in case they need to rest in its vicinity.

name: Wharf
description: The $wharf$ is a maritime structure at a port where ships can dock to transfer their cargo and to receive maintenance and repairs.

name: Medical School
description: With the rise of the $scientific_revolution$, the field of medicine is making new breakthroughs and growing in its methods and acquired knowledge. The $medical_school$ ensures that this knowledge is passed to new generations of physicians.

name: Lazaretto
description: A small hospital in an isolated location, usually in the countryside, an island, or a patch of the coastline. Maritime travelers are quarantined there if they are suspected to be carriers of a contagious disease, limiting the spread of epidemics drastically in the location.

name: Pest House
description: A small hut outside the of the borders of a community, where the sick and diseased are confined against their will to avoid the spread of plagues to the rest of the citizens.

name: Hospital
description: The history of the $hospital$ is old as many ancient civilizations had their own version of an institution which houses the sick. During the medieval period, the $hospital$ evolved further as it now focuses additionally to the health care and recovery of its patients.

name: Slave Market
description: A hub of trade where $slaves$ are bought and sold, fueling economies through forced labor.

name: Aqueduct System
description: Through carefully laid stone channels and gravity-fed conduits, this construct secures a steady supply of fresh water. While simple in construction, these works mark the first step toward organized urban water management.

name: Provincial Chancery
description: A branch office of our $chancery$ in the capital, this chancery office will both assist with our foreign diplomacy while also helping our local population in addressing their complaints.

name: Marketplace
description: A vibrant place of commerce where goods from near and far are exchanged, providing the lifeblood for local and regional trade.

name: Merchants Quarters
description: Bustling with traders, these quarters house shops and storage, serving as the economic heart where deals and exchanges flourish.

name: Grand Marketplace
description: This is a grand place of commerce, where deals and exchanges flourish.

name: Commerce Center
description: This lively center of commerce is where goods from near and far are exchanged for gold. This is the beating heart of the local trade.

name: Port Authority
description: The $port_authority$ oversees maritime traffic, enforcing regulations, collecting tariffs, and ensuring the safe flow of goods and business through the harbor.

name: Trade Company Headquarters
description: The seat of any future [ShowSubjectTypeName('trade_company')], the $trade_company_headquarters$ serves as the main base of operations for any international and oversea commercial activities on behalf of the motherland.

name: Company Garrison
description: The garrison of the [ShowSubjectTypeName('trade_company')] protects the local interests of the merchants.

name: Company Harbor
description: The local depots of the [ShowSubjectTypeName('trade_company')] houses all the merchandise ready to be sold.

name: Company Local Ventures
description: The ventures of the [ShowSubjectTypeName('trade_company')] which try to exploit the local materials for their benefit.

name: Company Foreign Influence
description: A colonial building of the [ShowSubjectTypeName('trade_company')] which offers opportunities for foreign pops.

name: Company Governance
description: The local military housing of the [ShowSubjectTypeName('trade_company')], recruiting and training troops which shall enforce the interests of the company.

name: Pounamou Carver
description: An artisan skilled in crafting intricate Pounamou artifacts, revered for creating items of cultural and spiritual significance.

name: Bardic School
description: A secular place of learning, the Bardic School trains students in the traditional arts of poetry, law, and history.

name: Hanseatic Kontor
description: Run by the Hanseatic League, this trading office is a vital cornerstone for facilitating lucrative commerce between northern European cities and overseas markets.

name: Hanseatic Shipwright Guild
description: This building designates the presence of experienced Hanseatic shipbuilders.

name: Hanseatic Town Hall
description: The beating heart of our merchant union, the town hall is a symbol of our widespread wealth and gravitas.

name: Fondaco
description: A multifunctional warehouse and lodging for foreign merchants, where business is conducted and wares are stored before distribution.

name: Venetian Arsenal
description: This is a state-run shipyard, responsible for the rapid construction of powerful naval fleet, playing a key role in maritime dominance.

name: Kurultai
description: The $kurultai$ is the symbol of the local council's authority, serving as an arbiter of important decisions and the mustering of men for the army.

name: Gallowglass Sept
description: This small community serves as both the head of a minor clan and the training grounds for its armored warriors.

name: Order Stronghold
description: A fortified base of the military orders, strategically positioned for defense and as a launching point for crusades or territorial control.

name: Order Commandery
description: An $order_commandery$ is a building owned by the military orders outside their own territory that serves two purposes: getting revenues from the exploitation of the surrounding lands and drafting new members for the order.

name: Bank
description: Through the $banking_office$ we provide small-scale investments into the population of other countries. At the same time it will serve as base of operation for our associated merchants.

name: Tribes of Galway
description: The local merchant families - or 'tribes' - maintain a complete stranglehold over the local politics.

name: Copenhagen Dockyard
description: The $copenhagen_dockyard$ provides the necessary ships and sailors to secure our naval dominance. Constructed within the well-suited harbors of $copenhagen$, the dockyard can operate faster than most other competitors.

name: Caravanserai
description: The $caravanserai$ are important milestones along the Silk Road, providing rest for both merchants and the animals carrying the valuable goods.

name: Caravan Stop
description: The $caravan_stop$ are important milestones along the trade routes of the desert, providing rest for both merchants and the animals carrying the valuable goods.

name: Cinque Port
description: One of the old Cinque Ports, this dockyard provides crucial naval support to the crown in exchange for historic autonomy.
