name: Royal Forest
description: The Charter of the Forest allows great hunting preserves to fall under the direct control of the Crown. A 'forest' in this sense is not necessarily heavily-wooded: just good for hunting.

name: Cardinal Seat
description: A clergyman, elevated to the rank of cardinal, grants us significant influence within the $catholic_church$.

name: North Sea Shipyards
description: The Netherlandish shipyards have the advantage of being able to hire from the best artisans and engineers of Europe making them very efficient and capable.

name: Galley Barracks
description: The $galley_barracks$ will house the slaves used to row our galleys and offer space for the construction of new ships.

name: Janissary Barracks
description: The local building where young slaves receive the military training to become a Janissary.

name: Ṣafawiyya Order Hall
description: The $safaviyya_order_hall$ is a building dedicated to the Sufi order of the Ṣafawiyya. While highly religious in nature, the building also serves as the military training grounds for the $qizilbash$.

name: Warrior Lodge
description: The $warrior_lodge$ is a gathering place where our warriors train, recount their deeds, and prepare for the next battle. Rooted in our ancestral traditions, it serves as a local center of recruitment where [ShowUnitDefinitionName('a_war_party')] and [ShowUnitDefinitionName('a_lodge_warriors')] can be trained.

name: $a_ghilman$ Barracks
description: The local building where young slaves receive the military training to become a $a_ghilman$.

name: Stannary Court
description: Court of law used by the tin miners of Cornwall and Devon, following the judicial independence granted to them by royal decree in 1305.

name: Lieutenancy
description: The Lieutenancy is the seat of the lieutenant, a royal delegate who governs a distant territory in the name of the crown. It shares the same governor cap as the [ShowBuildingTypeName('local_governor')], reflecting its role as an Iberian alternative to standard provincial administration rather than an additional layer of government.

name: Barcelona Royal Shipyard
description: The Barcelona Royal Shipyard, also known as 'Drassanes Reials de Barcelona', is located next to the harbor of Barcelona. The shipyard's history dates back to the 13th century and has undergone various expansions. It serves as a hub for shipbuilding, naval arsenal, and storage of galleys, playing a significant role in maritime activities.

name: Uffizi
description: $tuscan_uffizi_desc$

name: Ostrog
description: The $ostrog$ is a small, wooden fortification which is constructed in remote territories of Russia. Due to their reliance on lumber, Ostrogs are relatively inexpensive and swift to construct.

name: Pomor Outpost
description: The $pomor_outpost$ serves as the primary building for the gathering of fur and fish. Many peasants seek out these buildings in Siberian wilds in the hope of making a living of the fur trade.

name: Brethren of the Marsh
description: The port belongs to the Brethren of the Marsh, a maritime organization that carries international trade and creates a defensive net of those belonging to it. These ports are shipwright centers.

name: Sofa Barracks
description: The $sofa_barracks$ is a specialized $barracks$ which allows the owner to recruit [ShowUnitDefinitionName('a_sofa_infantry')] and [ShowUnitDefinitionName('a_mandekalu_cavalry')] in the [location|e].

name: Ç̌äwa Barracks
description: This is where Ç̌äwa Regiments are recruited.

name: King's Manor
description: The administrative center for judicial matters. Used by the Council of the North.

name: Polders
description: $polders_advance_desc$

name: Tēlpōchcalli
description: #italic Tēlpōchcalli#!, Nahuatl for 'house of young men', educates youth from fifteen onward for community service and war. Life there involves strenuous activities, cold baths, and frugal meals to strengthen the future warriors of our nation.

name: Calmecac
description: The #italic Calmecac#!, a noble school, offers rigorous education in history, religion, warfare, and more. Situated near [ShowLocationName('tenochtitlan')]'s Great Temple, it plays a key role in training for priesthood. Young commoners are educated in #italic Tēlpōchcalli#!, while potential noble leaders undergo training in #italic Calmecac#!, often by military orders.

name: Panaqa
description: This location is in the hands of the royal family of a previous ruler. The current monarch has no power over these lands.

name: Pukara
description: The $pukara_building$ is a building placed in hill or mountainous terrain, and serves both as weapon storage and as a defensive fortification. They incorporate the difficulty of the terrain into their design, making them comparatively cheaper and easier to construct and maintain than regular forts.

name: Terraces
description: The $terraces$ are sloped areas for the purpose of effective farming in the complex terrain of the Andes. Constructed on different height levels, the terraces can provide prime soil for many different crops in a close area.

name: Tambo
description: The $tambo$ is a supply depot of the Incas. The purpose of the $tambo$ varies significantly depending on the size of the structure. Smaller tambos serve as road stops for passing travelers while larger ones can even serve as an office for the province's administration.

name: Incamisana
description: The $incamisana$ is a temple in honor and worship of water and the divine patrons of it. As a combination of architectural beauty and technical ingenuity, the $incamisana$ has a dual purpose of being a religious building and an irrigation system.

name: Royal Society
description: The $royal_society$ is a scientific institution dedicated to advancing scientific knowledge through research, publications, and the promotion of scientific excellence.

name: Royal Academy of Arts
description: The $royal_academy_of_arts$ is an institution dedicated to promoting, inspiring, and advancing the world of visual arts and architecture through education, exhibitions, and the celebration of artistic talent.

name: Peel Tower
description: The $peel_towers$ is a defensive building which enhances the local fortification and makes the land recover from the devastation inflicted during conflicts.

name: Clan Seat
description: The $dun_fort$ is a fort constructed out of stone that serves as each clan's stronghold. These structures can be utilized by the clans to exert their unique position in our society.

name: Kokufu
description: The provincial governorships assigned to rule over the many provinces of $japan_region$, the position gives great power and influence to the family assigned to them.

name: Gosho
description: The imperial residences, called Gosho, are where the emperor establishes the court and officials. They serve as a focus of imperial presence and influence.

name: Yamashiro
description: Built exclusively as defensive positions in case of need, yamashiro are fortified hilltops with earthworks and wooden palisades rather than stone walls. The residences of the lords and retainers are at the foot of the hills, using only the fortified structures in case of an attack. Some of the most impressive yamashiro include fortifications on multiple hilltops, connecting them together by earthwork corridors and many layers of palisade fortifications.

name: Yakata
description: Originating from the residences of court nobility, the yakata are where the power of the warrior families congregates. Hosting facilities to gather their retainers as well as some elements for their defense, they host the best of each clan.

name: Shōen
description: Land assigned to be privately owned by a particular family or temple, they operate almost as independent manors or estates, becoming a great source of influence and wealth for their owners.

name: Tatara
description: The traditional way of smelting iron and steel, they serve to provide the metal for the production of high quality tools and weapons.

name: Clan Shipyards
description: Japan is a land of a long coast and many islands. As such, it is not uncommon for its people to host a small fleet of ships to navigate its waters.

name: Family Shrine
description: A shrine or temple dedicated to our family will not only serve to attend to the spiritual needs of our clan and our people, but it will also serve as the ideal place to instill reverence for our authority to the general population.

name: Land Gunnery
description:
$korean_gunnery_desc$
#Y Mutually exclusive with [ShowBuildingTypeName('korean_gunnery_coastal_defense')].#!

name: Coastal Gunnery
description:
$korean_gunnery_desc$
#Y Mutually exclusive with [ShowBuildingTypeName('korean_gunnery_land_defense')].#!

name: Kremlin
description: The $kremlin$ fortress acts as an administrative and spiritual center, as well as a symbol of authority to match our growing influence. It provides crucial shelter for the population against raids and sieges due to its imposing size and formidable walls and towers.

name: Stroganov School of Iconic Art
description: The $stroganov_school_of_iconic_art$ is devoted to the painting of religious icons typically associated with the [ShowReligionAdjective('orthodox')] faith. Funded by the influential Stroganov dynasty, it acts as a springboard for aspiring painters.

name: Venetian Palaces
description: The $venetian_palaces$ are a status symbol of the wealthy members of the oligarchic nobility and influential guilds alike. As space is limited in Venice, the residents of the city construct palaces that aim for height instead. The marvelous architecture then attracts people from afar to witness the Venetian culture firsthand.

name: Venetian Quarter
description: A trade district of the state of Venice. As long this quarter exists, the Venetian merchants will have significant influence in the affairs of Constantinople.

name: Galata
description: A trade district of the state of Genoa. As long this neighborhood exists, the Genoese merchants will have significant influence in the affairs of Constantinople.

name: Novodevichy Convent
description: The $novodevichy_convent$ serves as a refuge for noble women who have been forced to take the veil, and also strengthens the defensive capabilities of [ShowLocationName('moscow')] with its formidable walls and watchtowers.

name: Moscow Artillery Yard
description: The $moscow_artillery_yard$ is a center for technological innovations in artillery production. Engineers and craftsmen working in the yard contribute to the development of new designs and improvements in artillery technology.

name: Bund
description: A simple yet very effective water storage tank used for irrigation and for providing cities with the necessary water.

name: Kalari
description: The training ground for all those who learn the martial arts of Kalaripayattu. It also serves as barracks under the regulation of the Nair.

name: Ibadat Khana
description: The Ibadat Khana - #italic House of Worship#! - serves as a meeting place for spiritual leaders of diverse religions to engage in discussions and debates on religious teachings. It aims to foster understanding among different faiths, leading to the conclusion that all religions share a common goal.

name: Academy of Sciences
description: The $academy_of_sciences$ is the academic headquarters for prominent scientists, scholars, and intellectuals, both domestic and foreign, who contribute to a diverse and dynamic intellectual environment. It conducts extensive research in several fields, and publishes numerous scientific papers and journals.

name: Greek-Latin Academy
description: The $greek_latin_academy$ is a center of education for the teaching of the languages of Antiquity, along with grammar, poetics, and rhetoric. It appeals to both intellectual and pleb due to its diversified curriculum and affordable prices.

name: Sukharev Tower
description: The $sukharev_tower$ is the center of education for those fit for a life at sea. It houses the School of Mathematics and Navigation, which teaches the art of seamanship and mathematics, in turn producing some of the finest sailors to walk this earth.

name: Bock Fortifications
description: Getting advantage of the Bock, the promontory that offers a natural fortification to the city, we have built a formidable complex of defenses that has made our city earn the nickname of #italic Gibraltar of the North#!.

name: Ancient Great Wall of China
description: A gigantic series of walls and fortifications that spans the borders of a great Empire in multiple parts rather than a continuous wall, the $ruined_great_wall_of_china$ started to be built centuries ago. Although many dynasties have made repairs and expansions to it, centuries of abandonment have taken their toll on it and most of it is not much more than just ruins.

name: Great Wall of China
description: A repaired and well-maintained line of fortifications will protect our borders against any foreign barbarian invasion.

name: Free Economic Society
description: The $free_economic_society$ is a scientific and economic organization dedicated to promoting development in the fields of agriculture and commerce through research, acquisition of agricultural machinery, introduction of new crops, and publications on advanced methods of farming.

name: Imperial Academy of Arts
description: The $imperial_academy_of_arts$ is a dedicated institution with the mission to promote, inspire, and foster international influences in visual arts and architecture. This is achieved by sending notable painters and architects abroad, inviting guest lecturers, and continuously promoting the principles of Neoclassicism.

name: Moscow Orphanage
description: The $moscow_orphanage$ is a social initiative and experiment to mold abandoned children into ideal citizens. They are provided food and shelter in addition to basic education. Extended training opportunities are offered in factories or government offices once reaching adolescence. The orphanage is somewhat prone to high mortality rates.

name: Institute of Noble Maidens
description: The $institute_of_noble_maidens$ is a facility devoted to the education of noble women. Children are admitted at the age of six and remain within the confines of the institute for several years to ensure they are unaffected by out-of-institute influences.

name: Royal Atarazanas of Sevilla
description: The Royal Atarazanas of Sevilla are the most important shipyards in the Crown of Castile and one of the most important ones in the Iberian Peninsula, creating new ships for the Crown.

name: Al-Ḥamrā'
description: The $alhambra$, meaning #italic The Red One#!, is a palace and fortress complex located at Granada, which is considered the pinnacle of refinement of the Nasrid dynasty.

name: Theodosian Walls
description: Originally built on the orders of Constantine 'the Great', the walls elegantly guard one of Europe's most illustrious cities. Years later, when the double line of the walls was erected during the reign of Emperor Theodosius II, the city's defense became somewhat of a legend, being held in high regard and even considered impregnable.

name: Bey Fortress
description: A series of earthworks and fortifications, such fortresses are often found attached to large settlements where they operate as an extension of the local garrisoned towers and walls.

name: $mamluk$ Barracks
description: Barracks that house elite slave units. These facilities are equipped with the necessary amenities that will assist foreign slaves in learning our ways, studying religious texts, and training to become a disciplined warrior.

name: Coastal Settlement
description: A $coastal_settlements$ will attract much of our [pops|e] to move in there.

name: Kurmina Headquarter
description: Being the main garrison of a military province, this headquarter allows its governor to prepare their armies in case of a war, and protect the realm from any invader.

name: Great Enclosure
description: The Great Enclosure displays our control over the local [ShowGoodsName('livestock')] and can serve as a place of retreat in desperate times.

name: Great Hill Complex
description: A place of worship, the $great_hill_complex$ inhabits many artifacts made of soapstone and serves as a place for our most important rituals.

name: Great Valley Complex
description: A place providing plenty of housing, the $great_valley_complex$ will help us with the exploitation of resources in [ShowLocationName('great_zimbabwe')].

name: Trans-Saharan Trade Outpost
description: Built to secure spots for caravans, these Trans-Saharan outposts further allow their owners to spread their influence in the region.

name: Baray
description: A large reservoir of water, these structures will allow greater agricultural investment and grant us the ability to feed our population more reliably. Once constructed, these Barays will need close supervision and constant maintenance to avoid decay.

name: Bajang Ratu
description: A ceremonious gate of magnificent proportions, the $bajang_ratu$ follows the architectural design of a #italic candi bentar#!, or split gateway. Using high quality red brick, the gateway is to be one of the tallest constructs across the $MAJ_ADJ$ domain. Its usage is vital, as the structure is used for grand ceremonies of religious and political nature.

name: Bubu
description: Some of the most efficient fishing techniques are employed in local fish traps, known as $bubu_building$. Woven soft wood, such as bamboo, they are tended to by experienced fishermen in strategic locations such as river mouths and employed intricate techniques to maximize their catch.

name: Cattle-Rearing Pen
description: These cattle-rearing pens in this [location|e] allow for the [ShowCultureName('fulbe')] people to further specialize in their cattle-rearing ways.

name: Walls of $benin$
description: These walls allow [ShowLocationName('benin')] to prosper, keeping away any enemies that might seek to conquer it.

name: $zazzau$ Walls
description: A show of force against other nations in [ShowRegionName('guinea_region')], these walls show the might of the location to the neighbors.

name: Eghabho N'ore Mansion
description: The house of the town's chief. They are responsible for managing the location on behalf of the ruler.

name: Ribāṭ
description: A small fortification mainly meant to protect caravans or small areas from raids.

name: Feitoria
description: Armed with guns and coastal batteries, a $por_feitoria$ is able to secure our influence within the area and allow our merchants to more freely trade.

name: Gurgaddi
description: Guru Gaddi, meaning seat of the $guru$, is where the spiritual leader of [ShowReligionName('sikhism')] resides.

name: Sufi Mosque
description: A building constructed by local [ShowReligionGroupAdjective('muslim')] converts that represents a more syncretic approach to faith.

name: Wālī's Shrine
description: A shrine dedicated to a [ShowReligionGroupAdjective('muslim')] saint who has greatly helped spread [ShowReligionGroupNameWithNoTooltip('muslim')] in the area.

name: Zhīxiàn
description: The seat of a local magistrate overseeing the counties' administration, they are the imperial appointees extending the authority of the Dragon Throne to the provinces.

name: Seljuk Mint
description: The $seljuk_mint$ is a functional, secure site for producing coins, symbolizing political authority and fiscal stability.

name: Kocabaṣı Office
description: By using the locals of our conquered lands in the [ShowRegionName('balkan_region')], we can alleviate pressure from our own bureaucracy, at the cost of empowering the locals in the area.

name: Qal'at al-Mashwār
description: Deep in the heart of $tlemcen$ lies a fortified and beautifully illustrious palace complex. A symbol of local power and prosperity, the royal palace also serves as the administrative center of the seated dynasty. Besides its unparalleled beauty, it also serves as a defensive structure against foreign threats and prospecting conquerors.

name: River Toll Castle
description: A small castle placed along the river facilitates control over passing traders, granting our state a vital share of the local trade income.

name: Mountain Toll Castle
description: A small castle placed on a crucial mountain pass facilitates control over passing traders, granting our state a vital share of the local trade income.

name: Hippodrome
description: The Hippodrome stands as the beating heart of [ShowLocationName('constantinople')], where thunderous races, imperial ceremony, and the will of the people converge beneath the gaze of the ruler. Here, fans and contestants alike clash not only for glory upon the track, but for influence within the realm itself. Monuments seized from across the Mediterranean coasts adorn its spine, proclaiming dominion and legacy. Yet this grand arena is more than spectacle; indeed it is a crucible of public opinion, where acclaim can exalt a ruler for generations to come.

name: Porto Pisano
description: The great port of [ShowLocationName('pisa')] is the lifeblood of its owner. It is the point where the wealth of distant seas flows back into our coffers, welcoming traders and goods from all ports.

name: Gymnasium
description: $study_of_the_classics_desc$

name: Burgtor
description: Erected in the settlement's main gate, the $hsa_burgtor$ is a beautiful testament to our expertise in defensive matters as well as an astonishing display of our architecture and military capabilities.
